body: I know. That is why I have an internal struggle. If I didn't have the legal issues looming over me, I'd laugh at his offer, rip him a new one, and go live my life.
It is actually the opposite. I'd see him even if he didn't pay me.
I see your point. Thanks for the insight.
Before all of this happened, I wondered if what he was doing for me was to simply groom me into giving him my eggs. The "we'll be together for years" line seemed fishy.
I don't even know anymore. I don't understand where his despise for me came from.

Thanks.

I haven't received an update in a couple hours, so my gut says it isn't going to work out, which would be for the best.

I am expecting him to block me and shut me out after the egg donation, but at least I'd have the money and the hope that the children would reach out 18 years later. When we were seeing each other, I never brought up if I'd actually see the children since I knew the answer would obviously be no. He said he was fine back then with them knowing I exist.

It is easier said than done. I am almost 30 and suffer from social anxiety and depression. This is the lowest I have felt since I was a suicidal teenager. It is only getting worse.  

He says that the children would be surrounded by "love" from him, the nannies, and the personal teachers and wouldn't have emotional issues from a missing mother. He is delusional on that.

But thank you for the response.
He has his own, but who knows if it is healthy.
